name: Diagnosis & Candidate Learning
summary: Phase 9 implements the Diagnosis & Candidate Learning Engine enabling the agent platform to synthesize LearningCandidates and LearnedRules from empirical experiences, enforce sample size and counter-evidence eligibility thresholds, and prevent un-gated prompt/harness mutations.

invariants.immutability: PASS (Pydantic ConfigDict frozen=True on LearningCandidate & LearnedRule)
invariants.non_self_promoting: PASS (Candidates start strictly in PROPOSED state; cannot self-promote)
invariants.hard_rule_single_failure: PASS (1 failure generates candidate with sample_size=1, failing eligibility gate until threshold is reached)
invariants.distinction_of_concepts: PASS (Experience != MemoryFact != LearningCandidate != LearnedRule != Skill != Policy)
invariants.eligibility_thresholds: PASS (Scope-based sample size, confidence threshold, and counter-evidence gating enforced)
